hook: *30 Minutes* From Penn to Anuel AA
dek: Anuel AA plays UBS Arena Friday at 8 PM, here's the LIRR route in and out.

slides.label: The Show
slides.text: Anuel AA plays *UBS Arena* in Elmont this Friday, Nov. 6. The show is listed to begin at *8 PM*.

slides.label: The Move
slides.text: UBS Arena says take the train. *LIRR to Elmont-UBS Arena* runs about *30 minutes* from Penn or Grand Central Madison.

slides.label: From Jamaica
slides.text: Off the E, J or Z? You're already most of the way there, *catch the LIRR right at Jamaica Station*.

slides.label: Two Rules
slides.text: *Keep your ticket*, it gets checked before you exit the station. Zone 4 monthly or weekly passes work for this trip.

slides.label: Getting Home
slides.text: The ride home is where people get stuck. *Screenshot westbound trains after 11 PM* before the lights go down.

slides.label: What to Bring
slides.text: Bags max *12 x 12 x 6 inches*, no backpacks of any size. The arena is *cashless*, reverse ATMs sit by Sections 108 and 210.

slides.label: Why It Hits
slides.text: Since *Real Hasta la Muerte* dropped in 2018, Anuel AA's run has been the soundtrack: Concourse car speakers, Washington Heights house parties.

slides.label: Bottom Line
slides.text: Train, ticket, small bag. Do that, and the only thing you're worried about Saturday is *your voice*.

caption_linkedin:
Anuel AA plays UBS Arena in Elmont this Friday at 8 PM, and moving a full arena in and out smoothly is its own operations problem.

The venue's answer: push everyone toward one rail line. The LIRR gets you to Elmont-UBS Arena in about 30 minutes from Penn Station or Grand Central Madison, with a free shuttle on the other end. Small bag limits and a cashless building cut friction at the door.

The real bottleneck is always the exit. UBS Arena tells people to screenshot their train home before the show even starts, because the signal gets crowded when a full building reaches for their phones at once.

It's a simple lesson for anyone who runs events or manages a crowd: the entrance is easy to design for, the exit is where people get stuck.
